subject.title: chatCompletions: ignore request model when x-openclaw-agent-id header is present

question: Should OpenAI-compatible HTTP requests with a valid `x-openclaw-agent-id` ignore non-OpenClaw request-body `model` values and use the targeted agent's configured model, or should the strict agent-target `model` contract remain required?
rationale: The implementation change is small, but it changes a documented public Gateway API precedence rule for model selection and provider override semantics.

options.title: Accept narrow header compatibility
options.body: When a valid agent header selects an agent, ignore non-OpenClaw body `model` values for selection/validation, keep backend overrides in `x-openclaw-model`, and update docs plus sibling endpoint tests.

options.title: Keep strict model contract
options.body: Continue requiring `model` to be `openclaw` or an OpenClaw agent target even with the header, and improve docs/errors for OpenAI SDK clients that must send a model string.

recommendation.title: Accept narrow header compatibility
recommendation.body: When a valid agent header selects an agent, ignore non-OpenClaw body `model` values for selection/validation, keep backend overrides in `x-openclaw-model`, and update docs plus sibling endpoint tests.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current agent-first Gateway contract and has recent history in the resolver surface.
